newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Pannonplast Q1 profit up on product demand.
newsitem.headline: Pannonplast Q1 profit up on product demand.

text.p: Hungarian industrial plastics group Pannonplast Muanyagipari Rt on Friday reported higher earnings for the January-March quarter of 1997 on what it attributed to strong demand for packaging materials and pipes.
Pannonplast reported a consolidated IAS net income of 373 million forints for January-March 1997, compared to 338 million in the same three months of 1996.
The group's sales revenues surged to three billion forints in the first three months from 1.93 billion in the same period of 1996.
The company reported a gross margin of 976 million forints as against 666 million in January-September 1996, but the gross margin ratio decreased by two percent.
